'''Holding Cell 02021020''' was a detainee area of the former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor's]] [[Leonia Tavira's palace|palace]] in [[Yumfla]], [[Susevfi]]. [[Mirax Terrik Horn]] was held there after her capture by the [[Jensaarai/Legends|Jensaarai]].
